service_tier.description: Optional run-local OpenAI Fast request tier; server-served tier is not implied.

supersedes_command_id.description: Append-only historical replacement relation. On operator.repair_unclaimed_command or operator.adopt_staged_repair it names the exact earlier, unclaimed invalid command being superseded; it does not assert execution, success, or failure of that command. It must not be self-referential, point to a future command, or form a cycle. Ordinary commands omit this field.

withdraws_command_id.description: Append-only owner-withdrawal reference used by operator.withdraw_and_manual_start. It names the exact earlier command withdrawn before execution; it is not a supersede relation, must point to an earlier existing command, and must not be combined with supersedes_command_id.
